title: Women's Soccer: The Whole Road to College
title_html:
Women's Soccer:
The Whole Road to College
rules_checked: 11 November 2026, against the NCAA rule text, the printed Division I calendar, the NAIA handbook and the NJCAA procedures chart
levels: D1 and D2 and D3 and NAIA and junior college
kicker: Soccer · girls and women · grades 9 to 12 · sport playbook
sub: What to do, when to do it, who pays, and what a coach is and is not allowed to tell you. Built from the 2026-27 NCAA rule text, the printed Division I recruiting calendar, the NAIA and junior college rule books, and the women's pro league labor contract for 2024 to 2030.
edge: About 393,000 girls play high school soccer and 31,200 play it in the NCAA, which is 7.9 percent, and 2.8 percent reach Division I. In this sport four dead periods decide when a coach may watch at all, and a change that took effect on 1 July 2025 decides what a scholarship even means. Both are free to know before a family pays $299 for a showcase.
